subject: Transportation Systems
title: Birth of the Bullet Train
description: A quick, practical guide to Birth of the Bullet Train.

hook.text: In 1964, Japan launched the Shinkansen days before the Tokyo Olympics. It stunned the world.

buildup.text: The Tokaido line connected Tokyo and Osaka in four hours—half the time of the old express trains.

discovery.text: Japan built entirely new track with no curves sharper than necessary and no level crossings anywhere.

twist.text: Most experts predicted it would fail. Japan's national railway was nearly bankrupt at the time.

climax.text: Within two years, the line was profitable. It became the most successful railway project in history.

punchline.text: The bullet train was a gamble. It paid off in two years.
